description: Replace the caption and/or hashtags of one saved draft in Soclo with the supplied text. Pass its postId, current expectedRevision, draftPatch and a stable clientRequestId. Without confirm:true, previews and changes nothing; with confirm:true, saves only if it is still a draft at that revision and returns the receipt and current draft. Does not generate text, change media, schedule, publish or contact social accounts. Free; needs plan:create.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved this exact change. Omit or false for a preview that changes nothing.

name: soclo_posts_edit_draft
title: Edit a saved post draft
